# Yesser Barka

> Yesser Barka is a wedding photographer based in Sousse, Tunisia. He photographs weddings across Tunisia, including Tunis, Hammamet, Nabeul, Sidi Bou Said, and Sousse. There is no second office. Booking is the form at https://yesserbarka.com/contact-us/

## Locations

- [Wedding photographer in Tunisia](https://yesserbarka.com/locations/tunisia/): Country page. North coast, Cap Bon, and the Sahel, from a base in Sousse.
- [Wedding photographer in Tunis](https://yesserbarka.com/locations/tunis/): Greater Tunis, La Marsa, Carthage, Gammarth, and Sidi Bou Said. About 140 km from Sousse on the A1.
- [Wedding photographer in Sousse](https://yesserbarka.com/locations/sousse/): Home city. Medina, Hammam Sousse, Boujaafar, and Port El Kantaoui.

## Weddings

- [Chayma and Sami](https://yesserbarka.com/weddings/chayma-and-sami/): A wedding in Tunis.
- [Aymen and Chehd](https://yesserbarka.com/weddings/aymen-and-chehd-celebration/): A wedding in Sousse.
